title: Churned User Re-engagement
scenario: Identify users who did not book a trip for at least 30 days and then completed at least 5 trips in the following 7 days.
hint: Use LEAD/LAG to find inactivity gaps, then join with aggregate counts.
correctQuery: WITH Gaps AS (SELECT rider_id, request_date, LAG(request_date) OVER(PARTITION BY rider_id ORDER BY request_date) as prev_date FROM trips) SELECT DISTINCT g.rider_id FROM Gaps g JOIN trips t ON g.rider_id = t.rider_id WHERE (g.request_date - g.prev_date) >= 30 AND t.request_date BETWEEN g.request_date AND g.request_date + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY g.rider_id, g.request_date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trips (rider_id INT, request_date DATE);
